headerDisplay: Control a Dual CS 529 vinyl turntable / record player from Apple Home via Bluetooth LE.
footerDisplay: Leave Peripheral ID and Peripheral Name empty to auto-discover the first connectable Dual CS 529 / Dual CS turntable. Pin a device only if multiple compatible turntables are nearby.

deviceName.title: HomeKit Device Name
deviceName.description: Name shown for the vinyl turntable accessory in Apple Home.

peripheralId.title: Peripheral ID
peripheralId.description: Optional BLE MAC/address of the CS529 device for pinning. Leave empty to auto-discover.

peripheralName.title: Peripheral Name
peripheralName.description: Optional BLE peripheral name prefix to match during scanning (for pinning). Leave empty for auto-discovery.

serviceUuid.title: Service UUID
serviceUuid.description: BLE control service UUID. Defaults to the Nordic UART service UUID visible in the APK.

commandCharacteristicUuid.title: Command Characteristic UUID
commandCharacteristicUuid.description: BLE characteristic UUID used to write commands. Defaults to Nordic UART RX.

notifyCharacteristicUuid.title: Notify Characteristic UUID
notifyCharacteristicUuid.description: BLE characteristic UUID used to receive status notifications. Defaults to Nordic UART TX.

pollIntervalMs.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.description: How often to poll current status.
